cancel_failed.doc: the job could not be cancelled

comic_panel_count.doc: panel count out of range (params.min, params.max)

delete_failed.doc: the job could not be deleted

email_send_failed.doc: the email could not be sent

input_change_required.doc: the step failed in a way that repeats for the same request; change it before generating again

insufficient_credits.doc: the balance does not cover the reservation

internal.doc: server error; the message names the failed step only

invalid_comic.doc: comic request or document is invalid

invalid_token.doc: refresh or reset token invalid or expired

job_active.doc: the job is still running; cancel it first (params.status)

last_admin.doc: the last admin cannot be demoted

mime_mismatch.doc: the file content does not match its type

node_not_failed.doc: only failed steps can be retried

not_awaiting_review.doc: the job is not waiting for a preview decision

not_found.doc: the resource does not exist or is not yours

not_supported.doc: the operation does not apply to this resource

openai_not_enabled.doc: OpenAI image generation is not enabled for this account

price_changed.doc: the quote is stale; params.credits_total is the current price

provider_option_unsupported.doc: the option applies to another provider

provider_unavailable.doc: the provider is not configured here (params.provider)

provider_workflow_unsupported.doc: the provider does not offer this workflow (params.provider)

reference_format.doc: reference images must be PNG, JPEG or WebP

reference_incomplete.doc: a reference image has not finished uploading

reference_too_large.doc: a reference image is too large (params.max_mb)

reference_unavailable.doc: a reference image is missing, deleted or not yours

resume_failed.doc: the review decision could not be applied

retry_failed.doc: the step could not be retried

review_decision_invalid.doc: review decision names an unknown shot or conflicts (params.shot)

shot_refs_invalid.doc: a shot references itself or a later shot (params.shot)

shots_required.doc: at least one shot is required

sms_send_failed.doc: the SMS could not be sent

story_split_failed.doc: the story could not be split into panels; nothing was charged

submit_failed.doc: the job could not be created; no credits were held

text_length.doc: text too long or empty (params.field, params.max)

too_many_attempts.doc: too many code or sign-in attempts

trial_used.doc: the guest trial was already used

upload_missing.doc: the upload has not reached storage

upload_too_large.doc: the file exceeds the size limit

version_conflict.doc: the document changed elsewhere; params or body carry the server version

video_refs_exclusive.doc: first/last frames cannot be combined with reference media

failure.deadline_exceeded: the job exceeded its time limit
failure.executor_unavailable: no worker can run this step
failure.gate_expired: the preview was not confirmed in time
failure.input_unresolved: an upstream result the step needs is missing
failure.moderation: the provider blocked the content; the message may quote it and must not be shown
failure.poll_failed: the remote task status could not be read
failure.provider_account: the platform's provider account needs attention (balance or credentials); not the user's fault
failure.provider_busy: the provider was over capacity after all retries
failure.provider_ref_invalid: the remote task reference was lost
failure.timeout: the step exceeded its time limit
failure.unexpected_result: the step returned an unknown result
failure.worker_lost: the worker running the step stopped; retried while attempts remain
